newsitem.title: CANADA: Bell Canada Q4 net jumps to C$198 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bell Canada Q4 net jumps to C$198 mln.

text.p: BCE Inc unit Bell Canada said on Monday that it posted a fourth quarter net income of C$198 million versus year-ago C$138 million, for the seventh consecutive quarter of growth.

"The increase in earnings reflects revenue growth, the impact of the three-year transition plan, reduced pension service and increased depreciation expense," the telecommunications firm said in a news release.
Bell cut its staff by 3,400 to 44,900 by year end, it said.
Despite the jump in revenues for Bell Canada and parent BCE, BCE's chairman and chief executive called BCE's return on equity "inadequate."

"(Fiscal) 1996 was a year of successful recovery at BCE, with improved results in all major operating units. We must, however, achieve continued improvements in 1997. This year's return on equity of 10.6 percent is clearly inadequate to sustain the growth of the company," he said.
BCE posted a return of seven percent on common equity in 1995.
